import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "585fbf9340de57a9bc6fcd662e5979bb37a9c7c9"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
status = run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007" or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch} status={status!r}")

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt / "src")

suite = run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests"], check=False, env=env)
print("=== full stdout ===")
print(suite.stdout)
print("=== full stderr ===")
print(suite.stderr)
print("full_rc=" + str(suite.returncode))
if suite.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(suite.returncode)

print("head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
